summary: Clearway arterial kerb with no parked cars; the car park beside it is private.

drivers.seclusion: No homes within 25 m, but fully exposed to the road and dealership.
drivers.access_and_room: Lane runs to the kerb; only a thin planted strip, no pull-off.
drivers.traffic: Heavy arterial traffic beside a signalised junction.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along this kerb; clearway Mon-Sat 7am-7pm.

sun_shade: Tree canopy over the south end; open to the north.
